result.description:
Cyber Security Analyst | SOC Operations, Threat Hunting & Vulnerability Management   Your new company     Join a well-established public sector organisation dedicated to delivering critical services across Western Australia. Operating within a modern technology and security environment, the organisation is focused on strengthening its cyber security posture through proactive monitoring, threat detection, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.    Your new role     
 As a Cyber Security Engineer / Analyst, you will play a key role in cyber security operations, supporting the monitoring, investigation, and response to security incidents across enterprise environments. Working within a security-focused team, you will contribute to threat intelligence activities, vulnerability management, security assessments, and ongoing security improvement programs. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Monitoring and analysing security events, alerts, and incidents. 
 Performing SOC activities including incident triage, investigation, and response. 
 Conducting threat hunting and threat intelligence analysis. 
 Supporting vulnerability assessments, security reviews, and audit activities. 
 Assisting with penetration testing and security validation exercises. 
 Performing security assessments of systems, applications, and cloud environments. 
 Preparing security reports, recommendations, and technical documentation. 
 Supporting compliance with cyber security frameworks, standards, and best practices. 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful in this role, you will possess: 
 
 Experience in Cyber Security Operations, SOC, or Security Analyst roles. 
 Strong incident detection, investigation, and response capabilities. 
 Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel. 
 Knowledge of vulnerability management tools and security assessment practices. 
 Understanding of threat intelligence, threat hunting, and indicators of compromise (IOCs). 
 Exposure to network security technologies including firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, web proxies, and endpoint security solutions. 
 Knowledge of Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 security services. 
 Familiarity with cyber security frameworks including ACSC Essential Eight, ISO 27001, NIST, and ISM. 
 Relevant tertiary qualifications in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 
 Industry certifications such as Security+, CEH, SC-200, AZ-500, CISSP, or equivalent will be highly regarded. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Competitive hourly contract opportunity. 
 Opportunity to work within a mature cyber security environment. 
 Exposure to modern security technologies and enterprise-scale security operations. 
 Collaborative and supportive technical team. 
 Valuable experience contributing to critical cyber security initiatives. 
 Free onsite parking and excellent workplace facilities. 
 
  What you need to do now     
 If you're interested in this role, click ' apply now ' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description: Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd  Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled Metal Machinist (First Class) / CNC Machine Operator/Programmer to operate CNC machinery and manufacture precision components. The role involves machine setup, machining operations, reading technical drawings, performing quality checks, and ensuring products meet required specifications and standards.   Benefits   Competitive salary based on skills and experience.  Opportunity to work with advanced CNC machinery and precision engineering projects.  Supportive and professional team environment.  Opportunities for career development and skills advancement.  Stable employment with an established Australian manufacturing company.    Task & responsibilities   Set up and operate CNC machining equipment, including CNC milling and turning machines.  Read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and production instructions.  Perform machining operations to produce precision components.  Select and change cutting tools, fixtures, and machine settings as required.  Conduct quality checks using measuring equipment such as micrometers, verniers, and gauges.  Identify and resolve machining issues to maintain production efficiency.  Perform routine machine maintenance and maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Follow workplace health and safety procedures and quality control requirements.    Qualification & experience   Relevant trade qualification in machining, engineering, or manufacturing (preferred).  Previous experience as a Metal Machinist (First Class) / CNC Machine Operator/Programmer, or similar role.  Experience operating CNC milling and/or turning machines.  Ability to interpret technical drawings and use precision measuring instruments.  Strong understanding of machining processes, tooling, and quality standards.  Ability to work independently and as part of a production team.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.   About Company    Zenith Vinyl Pty Ltd is an Australian manufacturer based in Brunswick East, Victoria, specialising in vinyl record production and precision-engineered tooling for the global vinyl record industry. Established in 2013, the company combines advanced CNC machining, engineering, and manufacturing expertise to design and produce high-quality molds, tooling, spare parts, and vinyl records for customers in Australia and overseas. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and quality, Zenith Vinyl continues to support the growing global demand for premium vinyl manufacturing solutions. result.description: The trustee for the Mark Plummer Family Trust  MRP Industries Pty Ltd is seeking a qualified and motivated Motor Mechanic to join our growing team based at Perth Airport. We provide comprehensive vehicle servicing, maintenance, and repair services for one of Australia's leading car rental fleets operating at Perth Airport. This is an excellent opportunity to work with a diverse range of late-model vehicles in a professional, fast-paced workshop environment.   Benefits   Competitive salary of $79,500 – $82,000 plus superannuation.  Stable, full-time employment.  Opportunity to work on a modern fleet of rental vehicles.  Ongoing training and professional development.  Supportive team environment with opportunities for career progression.  Convenient Perth Airport location.    Task & responsibilities   Diagnosing mechanical and electrical faults using specialised diagnostic equipment.  Carrying out routine servicing, maintenance, and repairs on petrol, diesel, and hybrid vehicles.  Testing and repairing engines, transmissions, steering systems, suspension, braking systems, and other vehicle components.  Performing scheduled maintenance in accordance with manufacturer specifications.  Removing, repairing, replacing, and reassembling defective parts and components.  Conducting vehicle inspections and road tests to ensure repairs meet safety and performance standards.  Maintaining accurate service records and reporting repair requirements.  Ensuring all work complies with workplace health and safety procedures and industry standards.  Assisting in maintaining workshop tools, equipment, and a clean, organised work environment.  Working collaboratively with the workshop team to ensure timely turnaround of fleet vehicles.    Qualification & experience   Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology or equivalent qualification.  At least one year of relevant full-time post-qualification experience (or equivalent).  Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills.  Experience servicing a wide range of passenger vehicles.   About Company    MRP Industries Pty Ltd is a Western Australian automotive service provider specialising in the maintenance, servicing, and repair of passenger vehicles.
